LMKD recorded low-watermark package kills before test launch. Google processes aborted; Solar later aborted in Binder/NewStringUTF after system-server death. The final screen capture is truncated, so the initial obscuring window cannot be identified from this artifact. This attempt does not establish completion or correctness of Solar 8K.
action: No further identical retries. Preserve evidence and inspect emulator first-boot/resource configuration before another attempt. No pixel, lifecycle or focus assertion was relaxed.
